description:
Live pump.fun detection alerts with per-alert ACO decision.

    Args:
        minutes: lookback window (5-720)
        alert_type: optional filter — ignition | sudden_flow | pre_pump |
            whale_distribute | market_exit

    Returns recent alerts from our own pump.fun/Raydium behavioral collector
    (1350+ alerts/day): flow multiplier, smart buyer count and a decision
    per alert (WATCH_ENTER / EXIT_IF_LONG / AVOID). Not investment advice.
name: get_pump_alerts
